Workload_Assumptions.Target_Workload: Consolidating 4 Domain-Specialized 70B Full-FT Checkpoints (SQL, Legal, Code, Reasoning) Derived From Same Base Model

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: 4 Isolated Full-Weight 70B Inference Pools (Zero Merging; 1 Pool per Domain)
Configuration_Matrix.Merge_Algorithm: None (4 Separate 70B Deployments Behind Intent Router)
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Expensive baseline: duplicates 70B weights 4 times across underutilized domain pools

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Full Joint Multi-Task SFT + RL Retraining From Scratch Over All 4 Datasets
Configuration_Matrix.Merge_Algorithm: Data-Mixing Retraining (Requires Access to All Original Private Training Corpora)
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Slow and costly ($28.5k retraining per update); impossible when upstream training data is unavailable

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Naive Linear Weight Averaging (`W_merge = W_base + 0.25 * sum(tau_i)`) without Sign/Sparsity Filtering
Configuration_Matrix.Merge_Algorithm: Uniform Linear Task Arithmetic Across All 4 Task Vectors
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Anti-pattern for >=3 models: parameter sign conflicts and magnitude dilution degrade accuracy by -8.6 pts

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: `MergeKit DARE-TIES / DELLA` (Drop 85% Redundant Deltas + Rescale + Sign Election) + Layer-Adaptive Depth Weighting
Configuration_Matrix.Merge_Algorithm: `DARE` Sparsification (`p=0.85`, `1/(1-p)` Rescale) + `TIES` Majority Sign Election in 20 Minutes on CPU/1-GPU
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Production standard for zero-training multi-specialist consolidation (99.4% accuracy retention at -75% serving GPUs)
